name: Indiana
permitAge: 15 if enrolled in a BMV-licensed driver education (behind-the-wheel) program; 16 without driver education (handbook p. 3)

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, including at least 10 at night, logged on State Form 54706 (handbook p. 9; BMV driver education FAQ: required for all new drivers 18 or younger, even with driver education)
teen.nightLimit: Probationary license: first 180 days no driving 10 p.m. to 5 a.m.; after that until 18, not after 11 p.m. Sunday to Thursday, not before 5 a.m. Monday to Friday, and not 1 a.m. to 5 a.m. Saturday and Sunday. Exceptions: work, school-sanctioned activity, religious event, or a licensed driver 25 or older (spouse 21 or older) in the front seat (handbook p. 10; IC 9-24-11-3.5, 9-24-11-3.6)
teen.passengerLimit: Probationary license, first 180 days: no passengers unless a licensed driver 25 or older, a spouse 21 or older, or a driving instructor is in the front seat; own child, stepchild, sibling (incl. step/half) or spouse allowed (handbook p. 10). IC 9-24-11-3.5 also allows a parent/guardian or grandparent.
teen.phone: Drivers under 21: no telecommunication device at all, except to call 911 (handbook p. 10; IC 9-24-11-3.7). All drivers: may not hold or use a phone while driving unless hands-free; 911 exception (handbook p. 45; IC 9-21-8-59).

bac.under21: 0.02 (IC 9-30-5-8.5, Indiana Code 2025; not stated in the handbook)

notes: Learner supervisor for a learner under 18: licensed relative 25 or older, spouse 21 or older, or a licensed driver education instructor / driver rehabilitation specialist (BMV learner permit page).

A 15-year-old in driver education may practice with a parent only after 30 hours of the classroom or online portion and enrollment in a BMV-licensed behind-the-wheel program (BMV driver education page FAQ).
Probationary license age: 16 with driver education, 16 years 270 days without. Expires 30 days after the 21st birthday.
Move over (IC 9-21-8-35): change lanes away from a stopped emergency, authorized amber-light or hazard-light vehicle; if not possible, slow to 10 mph below the posted limit. Class B infraction.
School bus (IC 9-21-12-3): no stop needed when the bus is on the opposite side of a highway divided by a barrier, unimproved median or constructed dividing section.

Handbook checked 2026-10-09: Indiana Driver's Manual (English), back cover 'Published July 2026' (PDF created 2026-06-23). Printed page = PDF page minus 5. Spanish manual (drivers-manual-spanish.pdf) is an older edition (PDF modified 2024-02).

Knowledge exam: two sections (traffic signs; traffic rules/maneuvers), 80 percent or higher on each (handbook p. 63; BMV knowledge exam page). Number of questions is not stated by the handbook or BMV, so questions and pass stay null. Failed exam: retake the next business day (p. 5).

Knowledge exam languages (BMV knowledge exam page, 2026-10-09): Arabic, Burmese, Chin, Croatian, French, German, Haitian Creole, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Mandarin (Simplified Chinese), Polish, Punjabi, Russian, Serbian, Spanish, Swahili, Tagalog, Vietnamese; an applicant-arranged interpreter is allowed for other languages; ASL on request.
Learner's permit valid 2 years (p. 4). Skills exam retake after 7 days (p. 7).
